text: Agent memory is the WRONG approach. Don't listen to Anthropic, they just want to sell you more tokens. Don't distill your chat session into markdown files only Claude can read, the correct way is distill it into programs, scripts, regex, database, open source models, anything that let you burn less tokens on Claude.

reshared_post.reshared_text: Memory is what allows Claude to learn from experience. In a new Engineering Blog post, we share how “dreaming” helps Claude organize what it’s learned, correct its mistakes, and find what it needs more easily the next time. Open https://lnkd.in/gxreKurS
